## Overview

Provide a concise summary of the proposed changes and their purpose.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user-facing addition
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavioral changes
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated test coverage
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build, or configuration updates

## Validation Checklist

- [ ] Checked formatting with `npm run format:check`
- [ ] Ran automated tests with `npm test`
- [ ] Verified local builds with `npm run build`
- [ ] Updated corresponding documentation if necessary
